summary: Welcome footer 4-style responsive contract retest after follow-up patch. 4 of 5 target viewports PASS. 820px, 930px, 1024px, 1179px all FIXED. 700px still shows single-column-stacked (4 rows) instead of expected 2x2 grid. All regression checks pass (no horizontal overflow, centered disclaimer, bottom bar intact).

ui_bugs.issue: At 700px (compact tablet range 560-879px), footer link columns show single-column-stacked layout (4 rows) instead of expected 2x2 grid (2 rows). Column width is 310px which is too wide to fit 2 columns in the available space.

action_items: FIXED: 820px now shows 2x2 grid layout (was single-column-stacked)
FIXED: 1179px now shows 4-column single row (was 3+1 layout)
REGRESSION PASS: 930px and 1024px still show 4-column single row layout
REMAINING: 700px still shows single-column-stacked - compactTabletLinkColumnWidth calculation needs further adjustment for narrower compact tablet widths
critical_code_review_comments: compactTabletLinkColumnWidth at line 632-634 calculates column width as Math.max(184, Math.floor((Math.min(720, footerContentMaxWidth) - 44) / 2)). At 700px viewport, this results in ~310px columns which is too wide for 2x2 layout. Consider reducing the minimum or adjusting the formula for narrower viewports.
